spans.text: ■FILE■ PACC37628974765892—Decrypting...
Samantha Shaw (2009-2062),
Formerly known as Yekaterina Vasilievna Petrovskaya.
Petrovskaya graduated from St. Petersburg State University of Civil Aviation in 2028.
In the same year, she was selected to join the Air Force and performed flight missions as part of the squadron codenamed "Golden Jackal".
In 2030, the squadron took part in an emergency rescue operation in the Far East [Attachment 52] [Attachment 53].
In 2032, Petrovskaya and co. were received by *** and awarded medals [Attachment 54].
Decrypting Attachment 52...
Pzzt...
Golden Jackal 1 to Command, Golden Jackal 1 to Command.
Command copies.
Search and rescue in Area C23 complete. Golden Jackal has received 12 injured personnel, all with minor injuries, none with serious injuries. Requesting permission to return.
Report— Pzzt—
Command, say again.
After another burst of static, the voice resumes.
...severe interference! No personnel with serious injuries, confirmed?
...No serious injuries, confirmed.
Copy that! Command can't reach Coyote. Can you contact them?
Coyote has moved to Area C24 for search and rescue. Golden Jackal requesting permission to return with injured to support Coyote ASAP.
Golden Jackal, you are cleared to return. Depart from current position, maintain flight interval.
Departing from current position, maintain—
An explosion erupts in the distance like a thunderclap, and communications are cut off.
Click. Audio file playback ends.
Decrypting Attachment 53...
No sign of rescue target.
No sign of rescue target.
Continue the search. We'll proceed to Area C25.
Pyryev's eyes only work properly if he drinks enough vodka.
This bottle of vodka is my dad's birthday gift for me. You lot and those four bastards from Golden Jackal better keep your dirty paws off.
If we make it back to Moscow alive this time, save half the bottle for me.
Hey, have some faith. If we're lucky, we might not even live past tomorrow.
So why don't we just split the bottle right now?
Shut up. I'm getting you lot back alive.
The comms channel falls silent. Only the background noise of the helicopters in flight can be heard.
Village spotted at 3 o'clock! I see people!
Coyote 1 to Command, more rescue targets have been found.
No response from the comms channel.
**! What the hell is that?!
An explosion can be heard in the distance like a thunderclap through the channel.
Even the calm voice doesn't sound so calm anymore.

Coyote 1 to Command, a green fireball just fell from the sky northeast to our squadron, landing over ten klicks away. Is it related to the unknown explosion in the southern sea area? Requesting more information.
Still no response from the comms channel.
Warning! Radiation levels rising rapidly! Please evacuate to a safe area!
A series of alarm klaxons start blaring in unison.
Click. A switch seems to have been flipped, and all the alarm klaxons cease.
Should we withdraw?
We've lost contact with Command. According to regulations, we are allowed to withdraw under these circumstances.
...But you won't.
Look, those people in the valley are cheering so happily.
We've got to rescue them.
Maybe he just wants some... vodka...
The comms channel falls silent again. For some reason, nobody knows what to say.
Wolf to Coyote! Wolf to Coyote!
A youthful voice calls out through the comms channel, but nobody from Squadron Coyote responds.
Golden Jackal to Coyote! Golden Jackal to Coyote!
This time it is Yekaterina shouting into the comms channel.
Coyote, respond!!!
Bam!!! Then comes the violent and unmistakable sounds of collision, explosion, and a rockslide. It's all over.
Decrypting Attachment 54...
I hear you guys got a taste of radiation overexposure during the rescue mission. How are you feeling now?
It's a celebration. I shouldn't be drinking water.
You're absolutely right. It's not a celebration without vodka, is it?
As the star of this celebration, is there anything you want in particular?
If it's possible, I'd like to study at the Zhukovsky Air Force Engineering Academy.
Ooh, such ambition!
You're as ambitious as a man!
...I hope...
Some day, people will say this about students of the Zhukovsky Academy—
"Such ambition!"
"You're as ambitious as Yekaterina Vasilievna!"
